method.olympic_side: athlete_events.csv filtered to Year 1980-2016 with non-null Medal (21926 athlete-event medalist records, Summer+Winter). Country keyed via noc_regions.csv NOC->region (8 rows with unmapped NOC 'SGP' dropped -> 21918). Missing Olympic heights (383) imputed with sport-level median of the same 1980-2016 medalist subset (global median 178.0 as unused fallback); imputed values span 161-193 cm.
method.nba_side: team.csv filtered to year_founded > 1970 -> 13 teams (Cleveland Cavaliers, LA Clippers, Portland Trail Blazers at exactly 1970 are excluded). Inner join on team.csv.id == common_player_info.team_id -> 911 players; heights parsed from feet-inches as (ft*12+in)*2.54 (0 nulls in the filter, position-group median imputation was a no-op); 1 player with null country excluded from the country set.
method.country_standardization: Whitespace strip + alias map NBA->Olympic vocabulary: Antigua and Barbuda->Antigua, Cabo Verde->Cape Verde, Congo->Republic of Congo, DRC->Democratic Republic of the Congo, St. Vincent & Grenadines->Saint Vincent, Trinidad and Tobago->Trinidad, US Virgin Islands->Virgin Islands, US, United Kingdom->UK. Unmatched NBA labels (no 1980-2016 Olympic medalist rows): Belize, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Republic of Congo, Saint Lucia, Scotland.
method.probability_rule: shared_countries = 42; NBA median height over the 905 qualifying NBA players from shared countries = 200.66 cm (same as over all 911); denominator = 16243 Olympic medalist records from shared countries; numerator = 460 records with height > 200.66 cm; probability = 460/16243 = 0.028319 -> 0.0283

sensitivity_checks.manual_SGP_mapping: no effect (Singapore has no qualifying NBA players)

notes: All reported figures reconcile with the reference checkpoints in analysis_plan.json. Result is robust to the height-imputation choice because all imputed Olympic heights (<=193 cm) fall below the 200.66 cm threshold.
